description: The Citizens' Service Bureau (CSB) is the customer service department for the City of St. Louis. This dataset provides access to some of the data collected when services are requested. The X/Y coordinates are in WGS 84 Web Mercator (EPSG:3857). File new service request here: [https://www.stlouis-mo.gov/government/departments/public-safety/neighborhood-stabilization-office/citizens-service-bureau/csb-request-submit.cfm](https://www.stlouis-mo.gov/government/departments/public-safety/neighborhood-stabilization-office/citizens-service-bureau/csb-request-submit.cfm)

table:columns.name: CALLERTYPE
table:columns.description: Method used by the customer to report the issue — Phone, Web, Twitter, CSB LTR, CSB VCML, etc. (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: DATECANCELLED
table:columns.description: Date cancelled — indicates the request was a duplicate, cancelled by the caller, or entered in error (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: DATEINVTDONE
table:columns.description: Date the investigation/inspection was done, which may differ from when a clerk closed the request (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: DATETIMECLOSED
table:columns.description: Date/time the request was closed, auto-stamped when an employee closed it (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: DATETIMEINIT
table:columns.description: Date/time the request was initiated, auto-stamped when saved or submitted online (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: DESCRIPTION
table:columns.description: Same as the problem code or a more specific explanation of it (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: EXPLANATION
table:columns.description: Additional details about the problem code, including the conditions under which it should be used (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: GROUP
table:columns.description: Category the Citizens' Service Bureau currently groups that request type within (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: NEIGHBORHOOD
table:columns.description: City neighborhood number 1-79 of the problem location (portal field definition, city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: PARENT_ID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the parent problem-code node in the CSB problem-code hierarchy (GRANDPARENT_ID/PARENT_NODE/GRANDPARENT_NODE are the higher levels; inferred from names — not in the portal field list).

table:columns.name: PRJCOMPLETEDATE
table:columns.description: Projected completion date — the date by which the responsible division (SUBMITTO) should have the initial inspection completed (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: PROBADDRESS
table:columns.description: Address or intersection where the problem is occurring (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: PROBADDTYPE
table:columns.description: Problem address type: A = Parcel, B = Intersection (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: PROBLEMCODE
table:columns.description: Type of report — the CSB problem code (portal field definition); PLAIN_ENGLISH_NAME_FOR_PROBLEMCODE is its public title.

table:columns.name: PROBLEMSID
table:columns.description: Internal identifier of the problem record (name-based; not in the portal field list).

table:columns.name: PROBZIP
table:columns.description: ZIP code of the problem location, often blank (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: PUBLICRESOLUTION
table:columns.description: Public-facing resolution text recorded when the request was resolved (name-based; not in the portal field list).

table:columns.name: REQUESTID
table:columns.description: System-generated unique record number for the service request (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: STATUS
table:columns.description: Status of the request (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: SUBMITTO
table:columns.description: City division or department responsible for handling the request (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: WARD
table:columns.description: Ward number of the problem location (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>
